# Morphiqo

> Morphiqo swaps faces in videos and photos entirely on the user's own device.
> Nothing is uploaded: there is no server, no account and no copy of the user's
> media anywhere but their own hardware.

Morphiqo is an app for iPhone, iPad and Mac, distributed through the App Store.

## How it works

- Face detection, identity encoding, swapping and optional enhancement all run
  locally, using the device's own CPU, GPU or Neural Engine.
- The AI models are too large to ship inside the app, so on first launch it
  downloads roughly 900 MB once, over HTTPS. Every byte is checked against a
  SHA-256 digest before use.
- After that download, the app works with the network switched off entirely.

## Requirements

- iPhone and iPad: iOS 17 or later.
- Mac: macOS 14 or later, Apple silicon or Intel.

## Privacy

- No accounts, no advertising, no crash-reporting SDK.
- Photos and videos are never transmitted. Face embeddings are computed on the
  device, held in memory for the current job only, and discarded — they are never
  stored, never profiled and never compared against any database of people.
- Exported files carry no tag identifying the app that produced them, and the
  original photo's location and camera metadata do not survive the swap.
- This website counts page views in aggregate, cookielessly. The apps themselves
  contain no analytics of any kind.

## Responsible use

Morphiqo alters images of real people. Only swap faces of people who have agreed
to it.
